scenario: ordinary-page reloadable full-app sleep/wake memory + acceptance

source.shelfGate: equal HEAD and SHA256 of every file in src (tracked and untracked), this fixture, package.json and electron.vite.config.ts
source.note: treeDirty records an uncommitted working tree; the checkout is shared with unrelated concurrent work, so whole-tree drift is reported but not gated. The dist hashes are the authoritative identity of the app under measurement and are verified unchanged before every fresh app.

before.description: reloadable sleep path disabled; ordinary pages stay live and are reloaded once per cycle

after.description: production contract: idle ordinary pages deep-sleep and wake with restored scroll/zoom/session

method.aggregation: per sample: max privateBytes per PID, summed over PIDs; Windows private bytes include Browser/Tab/GPU/Utility/Zygote/service processes
method.excluded: no JS heap totals, no external/working-set arithmetic
method.phases: boot includes startup/open-all; loaded is3s with12 live pages; transition is demand withdrawal/idle/verification, not steady; sleep is3s after checks; cycles includes the whole navigation/input loop; final is3s steady. Same windows and budget in both arms.

memory.rawSamples: full 100ms per-PID raw samples stay in each run directory (result.json); the run list below points at them

definition.readyMs: cycle start (real clock) -> page presented through the real shelf UI, live, content+session verified, input gate interactive, activation checked
definition.wheelMs: full software wheel scenario including setup, failed main-window attempt, fallback/retry and 25ms polling -> observed movement; not hardware latency
definition.wheelDelivery: attempt order: main-window webContents.sendInputEvent -> guest webContents.sendInputEvent (two ticks) -> scroll reset + guest tick. The recorded observer counts show which delivery actually reached the page; the main-window wheel does not reach a webview guest in this build, so samples are dominated by guest-level software input
definition.excluded: no read-only scroll IPC exists in ordinary mode and none is fabricated; keyboard/IME/OS-hardware input latency is NOT claimed

fixture.consentNote: recovery.reloadableMode=true simulates prior per-URL consent. Codex GUI checks exercise actual menu/main IPC with fixture-scoped dialog responses simulated; no real user operation is auto-approved.

limitations: Synthetic activation: a hidden window cannot gain hardware user activation, so a page that is not already active is activated with a test-scoped executeJavaScript('void 0', true) after a no-gesture read, and then re-read without a gesture to verify navigator.userActivation.hasBeenActive===true. Every synthetic path is labelled synthetic/software, never hardware input.
Software wheel timings include failed host delivery and labelled guest delivery/retries, setup and25ms polling. They are fixture scenario timings, not keyboard/IME/OS hardware latency.
Reading fixtures use fixed-width layout and browser zoom1.25. Responsive real pages can reflow between task and main view, altering pixel scroll offsets; scroll restoration is best-effort.
Memory is Windows private bytes only, summed over the app process tree; it is a process-level proxy, not a per-page attribution.
Explicit consent plus the reloadable safe-snapshot guard block many real sites; results cover the ordinary fixture contract only, not universal real-site coverage.
The protected page may persist sleep metadata even though its native close was refused; such a record is classified separately and never counted as a sleeping page.

Real UI consent/dialog handling is covered by the owner GUI checks (actual menu + main IPC exercised with a fixture-scoped native dialog stub); this scenario exercises the real shelf UI presentation/release path and reads seeded per-URL consent only.
Sleep metadata on disk (ShelfWebSleep v1) has no method field; GET is an enforced contract invariant rather than a persisted property, so no on-disk method assertion is made.
Source identity hashes every src file and this fixture; dist hashes independently identify the exercised build.
methodNote: Same build,12 ordinary pages, fixed layout and browser zoom1.25, alternating fresh-process order. Each cycle does exactly one GET navigation: before reloads the retained guest; after creates/loads the sleeping counterpart. Both verify content/session/actual input gate, software wheel, zoom/nonzero scroll. The sole feature switch is LYSHELL_SHELF_RELOADABLE_SLEEP=0 in before.
